returns._0: The deposited USDC balance (atomic units, 6 decimals).

params.gatewaySignature: Gateway's PoT signature over                         ``keccak256(abi.encodePacked(taskId, developer, amount))``.

params._treasury: Address that receives the 5 % protocol treasury.
params._usdc: Address of the USDC token contract on Base.

params.amount: Amount of USDC to deposit (6 decimal atomic units).

returns._0: The developer's EVM address, or address(0) if unregistered.

params.deadline: UNIX timestamp; revert if block.timestamp > deadline.
params.skillIdHash: keccak256(skill_id) — used to look up the developer.
params.totalAmount: Total settlement amount in USDC (6 decimals).
params.user: The user whose deposit is charged.
params.worker: The worker that executed the task.

MAX_TIMEOUT().notice: Maximum timeout window for a task (in seconds).

balances(address).notice: Per-address deposit balances (user → USDC amount, 6 decimals).

claimDeveloperReward(bytes32,bytes).notice: Claim the developer's 70 % share for a settled task.         The developer must be the registered developer for the skill         and present a valid gateway PoT signature.

claimReward(bytes32,bytes).notice: Claim the worker's 25 % reward for a settled task.         The worker presents a PoT — an ECDSA signature from the         gateway over ``keccak256(abi.encodePacked(taskId, worker, amount))``.

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposit USDC into the contract.  User must have called         ``USDC.approve(address(this), amount)`` first.

developers(bytes32).notice: Developer registry: skill_id hash → developer wallet address.         Set by the gateway when a skill is uploaded.

gateway().notice: Gateway oracle address — the signer of settlement authorizations.

getDeveloper(bytes32).notice: Look up the developer for a skill.

getTaskSettlement(bytes32).notice: Get the full settlement snapshot for a task.

hasClaimedWorker(bytes32).notice: Per-party claim tracking — worker and developer claim independently         so the first claim does not block the second.

isCompoundNonceUsed(uint256,bytes32).notice: Check if a compound nonce has been used.

refundTask(bytes32,address,uint256,strin.notice: Refund a task that has timed out.  Only the gateway can trigger         a refund (to prevent griefing).  The full ``totalAmount`` is         returned to the user's deposit balance.

registerDeveloper(bytes32,address).notice: Register or update the developer wallet for a skill.

setGateway(address).notice: Update the gateway oracle address (key rotation).

settleTask(bytes32,address,address,bytes.notice: Settle a completed task.  The gateway signs an ECDSA authorization         binding ``(taskId, worker, totalAmount)``.  Anyone can submit it.         On success:           - Deducts ``totalAmount`` from the user's deposit balance.           - Credits 70/25/5 to developer / worker / treasury.           - Stores a settlement snapshot so the three parties can claim.

treasury().notice: Platform treasury address — recipient of the 5 % protocol tax.

usedCompoundNonces(bytes32).notice: Compound nonce guard: keccak256(nonce, taskId) → used.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraw previously deposited USDC back to the user.
